1.title: Out of Life
1.swarm_name: State Machines & Interactive Loops · Norstein Multiplane · Object Transfer
1.trick: Window slides away on its wall-rail at the exact velocity the Poet steps toward it (d(window_x)/dt == d(poet_x)/dt); sodium Orange Haze claims the room L->R while the EX stays back-only.
1.threshold_rule: At t=32.0s only the #5aa7ff blue vape ember remains in the black (q_end >= 0.88).
1.signature_constraint: EX never turns around (view == back on 100% of frames); window_x tracks poet_x.
1.relay_in: Poet at acrylic lectern opens the reading circle into the dim high-rise bedroom.
1.relay_out: 01 -> 02: Camera pushes straight into the Poet's dilating pupil on the dark bedroom floor.

8.threshold_rule: Soul completes cooling arc and holds permanent 2-cel parallax offset (q_end >= 0.86).
8.signature_constraint: After t=6.0s, ||pos(Soul) - pos(Body)|| >= 4.0px on 100% of frames.
8.relay_in: 07 -> 08: Arrives at the top of the red Spire Elevator Shaft onto the Ankhu rooftop.
8.relay_out: 08 -> 09: Steps off the club curb into 03:30 neon rain beside the harbour phone booth.
